content:
I am trying to build several sessions, some of which have the option document=pdf enabled in their ROOT files. I want to build the sessions without generating the documents, but running something like
isabelle build ... -o document=false does not seem to work. Is this not the right way to suppress the document generation for this specific build?
Sorry to necro this thread. Did you ever figure it out? I'm running into the same issue.

Session options take precedence, so you cannot overwrite it like that.
If the session does not set document_variants, you may be able to skip document generation by using -o document_variants= (i.e. empty document variants)

Thanks for clearing that up so timely.

Just to document for anyone else running into this thread: I'm making a setup script for a docker-based artifact, and I've settled on the following structure: provide two root files (ROOT_no_pdf and ROOT_pdf), requiring the user to copy the right one in before running my build scripts depending on what they want. That, and including the -c flag in all my isabelle invocations to make sure the cache is cleaned. This ensures PDFs are built when I want them to. Somehow if the theory is in the cache already somehow latex+pdf generation is not triggered. Not a problem but a bit annoying if you're an oblivious noob like me.

Makes it all a bit slow, luckily my isabelle development takes only a minute to check so that's okay. Would be nice to have an "on-demand" PDF generation button in the isabelle tool, though I understand it's not really a priority.
Maybe you can use isabelle document...? You can build and later use document.
Gosh, not sure how I missed that. If I'll have time I'll experiment with that a bit. Thanks!
